alternative_notation.dimension_formula: osp(2m|2n) with m=1; even = 2n^2 + n + 1, odd = 4n

kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: odd central element carrying the inhomogeneous deformation (Schema 2+)

K.label: K
K.role: even central element; identified with the scalar 1, excluded from basis/PBW

inhomogeneous_deformation.bracket: [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa * gamma(X,Y)   (kappa normal-ordered to the left)

gb_matrix.parity_note: gb multiplies the odd central kappa in a mixed-parity bracket; numerically the gb are ordinary (commuting) scalars

inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_target: basis + K; Z = 'K' is the central part kappa*1 of the bracket
